description: Angular component for managing mobile app bundles, including form handling, dialog interactions, and API calls for saving and updating bundles within the Thingsboard platform.

classes.name: MobileBundleDialogComponent
classes.description: Angular component for creating and editing mobile app bundles with multi-step form, dialog interactions, and API integration.

methods.name: backStep
methods.description: Navigates to the previous step in the form.

methods.name: nextStep
methods.description: Advances to the next step or saves the bundle if on the last step.

methods.name: nextStepLabel
methods.description: Returns the label for the next step button based on current step.

methods.name: changeStep
methods.description: Handles step change events, updating the selected index.

methods.name: createApplication
methods.description: Opens dialog to create a new mobile application and updates form with its ID.

methods.name: createClient
methods.description: Opens dialog to create a new OAuth2 client and updates form with its ID.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Saves the mobile app bundle via API calls.

methods.name: mobileAppBundleFormValue
methods.description: Constructs the form data object for saving.
